facts.answer_text: The most likely diagnosis for bilateral pulmonary nodules in an asymptomatic heart transplant recipient with pacemaker is metastatic disease. This means that the nodules could be a sign of cancer that has spread from another part of the body to the lungs. However, it is important to consult a healthcare professional for a thorough evaluation and proper diagnosis of the underlying cause of these findings.
